meta.description: 暖纸背景 + Playfair, 左侧学习目标常驻, 含 MCQ 自测页

copy.tagline: 创建带自测页的课程幻灯片
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要设计带学习目标和自测的课程模块
copy.tagline_en: Create course slides with self-assessment pages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to design course modules with learning objectives and quizzes

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会生成一套教学幻灯片，包含封面、学习目标、正文、选择题自测和总结页，左侧始终显示学习目标。
howto.when: 当你要求制作课程、培训或工作坊的幻灯片时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一个关于Python入门的课程幻灯片。
say.note: Claude 会生成包含学习目标和自测题的完整课件。

say.text: 为下周的培训制作一个模块，主题是项目管理。
say.note: Claude 会生成带学习目标和选择题的培训模块。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude generates a set of teaching slides including cover, learning objectives, content, MCQ self-test, and wrap-up, with learning objectives always visible on the left.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to create slides for a course, training, or workshop.

say_en.text: Create a course slide deck for Python basics.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a complete course with objectives and self-test.

say_en.text: Make a training module on project management for next week.
say_en.note: Claude will produce a training module with objectives and MCQ.
